request.summary: Create an editorial weather window that uses Wallboard's platform weather service rather than a customer-managed datasource.
request.audience: Visitors and staff reading local conditions and the near forecast from shared signage.
request.primaryGoal: Make the current condition immediately legible while proving cached platform weather media, deterministic preview data, and designed service-failure states.

assumptions: The configured city and ISO country code resolve through the Wallboard weather service.
Weather image URLs returned by the SDK are already routed through the platform cache.
This proof is a purpose-built weather composition, not a replacement for the production app's universal theme and icon catalog.

surfaceStrategy.rationale: Weather signage commonly appears full-screen, in portrait lobbies, compact panels, and wide information bands.

surfaces.purpose: Cinematic landscape weather window with one current-condition hero and a forecast horizon.
Horizontal information band that preserves current conditions and the full forecast strip.
Portrait lobby composition with a tall weather hero and stacked forecast horizon.
Compact weather tile that removes secondary details before reducing primary text.

ownership.rationale: Wallboard resolves, localizes, and caches weather data and media through the SDK weather service.
The generated visual identity and resilient composition remain code-owned.
Operators select the location and localization without editing code.
Operators control the small set of choices that materially change the forecast presentation.

views.purpose: Show the current condition, location details, and near forecast.
Keep the designed composition while the first platform request is pending.
Explain that weather is temporarily unavailable without showing fake live values.

session.expectation: The passive board refreshes weather on a self-correcting schedule and preserves the last good reading during transient failures.

rendering.rationale: Current conditions and forecast items recompose between horizontal, vertical, compact, and wide-low surfaces.

motion.rationale: A restrained atmospheric reveal supports service updates; Off removes decorative motion without changing refresh behavior.

media.fallback: Render the condition-driven color field and atmospheric line work without an empty image box.
media.rationale: The weather service owns condition-aware background resolution and the SDK routes returned URLs through platform caching.

media.fallback: Use the typographic condition name and a CSS weather mark instead of a broken image.
media.rationale: The current and forecast condition icons come from the same platform weather response.

branding.provenance: Atlas Weather Window is a synthetic editorial identity created for the platform proof.
branding.fallback: Use location and weather content as the first-viewport identity rather than inventing customer branding.

settings.purpose: Sets the city name or postal code sent to the platform weather service.
Sets the ISO country code paired with the configured city.
Optionally overrides the returned city label without changing lookup.
Selects Celsius or Fahrenheit weather values.
Selects three to five forecast days.
Selects the weather service background family.
Selects Off or Subtle atmospheric motion.

dynamicText.fallback: Use two lines and preserve the room-readable floor before ellipsizing pathological location labels.
dynamicText.rationale: The location is a primary room-reading target and may vary by locale.

dynamicText.fallback: Keep two lines and omit tertiary weather details before shrinking further.
dynamicText.rationale: Localized condition descriptions vary materially in length.

dynamicText.fallback: Use two lines, then ellipsize only after the signage-readable floor is reached.
dynamicText.rationale: Forecast condition labels are localized and share bounded horizon cells.

states.expectation: The horizontal band keeps location, current value, and all configured forecast days visible.
The hero fills the upper field and forecast days become a spacious vertical horizon.
Secondary atmosphere details disappear before primary text becomes too small.
A long localized place name remains contained and room-readable.
Long translated current and forecast descriptions fit without clipped descenders.
Absent weather images use the designed atmospheric fallback without broken-image chrome.
One or two valid forecast entries expand deliberately instead of leaving empty reserved cells.
An initial service failure shows a designed unavailable state and no fabricated readings.
A refresh failure preserves the last valid reading and marks it as awaiting an update.
Weather retrieval and layout remain functional with decorative motion disabled.

behaviors.expectation: String and numeric SDK temperature fields normalize into stable current and forecast view models.
Weather background and icon URLs pass through the SDK platform cache path before rendering.
Settings changes refetch the configured location and scheduled refreshes do not blank the last valid state.

visualDirection.summary: A cinematic environmental window: full-surface weather imagery, oversized temperature, typographic location identity, and an unframed forecast horizon.
signatureChoices: Weather media is the canvas rather than a thumbnail inside a card.
The current temperature and location form one asymmetric broadcast-scale hero.
Forecast days share a continuous horizon line instead of repeating dashboard cards.
avoid: Generic KPI cards, nested panels, or a centered mobile-weather-app layout.
A universal settings catalog copied from the production Weather app.
Shrinking localized labels below signage-readable floors to preserve tertiary details.

visualReview.intent: The app should feel like a live view into the local atmosphere, not a weather dashboard assembled from interchangeable components.
focus: Inspect image contrast and designed media fallback across every declared ratio.
Verify long translated labels retain descenders, line-height, and room-readable scale.
Confirm short forecasts expand coherently and unavailable weather never presents fake live values.
